title: DavidHDev/canvas-ui

why_good: The library's focus on creative canvas components with WebGL effects can attract designers and developers looking for high-performance visual solutions.
value: Companies in gaming, advertising, and web design could pay for premium features or support, generating revenue through subscriptions or licensing.
